verdict.rationale: Integrated payment processing is a fair question for a commerce platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains only a Payment Module documentation title, with nothing showing first-party processing, published card rates, payouts, or fraud tooling that would remove the need for a third-party gateway. A module title alone is at most a developer building block, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can take payments with the platform's integrated processing — published card rates, payouts, and fraud tooling — without wiring a third-party gateway
